0022600107.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-0, first in the Southeast and East, on a two-game winning streak) host the Houston Rockets (2-0, first in the Southwest and third in the West, also on a two-game winning streak), with both teams unbeaten so far. Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out for Atlanta, while Houston's Fred VanVleet (rest) is day-to-day, and Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (rest) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Hawks lost both games, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
